# Card
Atlas Card v1 — surface container. 4 variants (default, outlined, elevated, filled) × 3 sizes × 5 states (60 total). filled uses background-muted with no border, matching code. Compose with Atlas typography & spacing inside.

USE WHEN
· Grouping related content on a raised or bordered surface: a settings group, a summary block, a selectable option.

DON'T USE WHEN
· As a generic container just for spacing.
· Nested more than one level deep.

DO
· Keep one idea per card.
· Use the Header, Title, Description, Content and Footer slots instead of styling your own header row.

DON'T
· Put a card inside a card inside a card.
· Use elevated on a surface that is already raised, such as a dialog.

PROPERTIES
Variant: default | outlined | elevated | filled. Size: sm | md | lg. State: default | hover | focus-visible | active | disabled.
